changes.title: Aphrodite: The Making of a Goddess
changes.summary: The civilisations that first created Aphrodite disappeared long ago. Her image never did. Step into the world of Aphrodite, the Greek goddess of love, beauty and desire – later worshipped by the Romans as Venus – in this major exhibition. Few figures in human history, and fewer women still, have remained so influential for more than 5,000 years. From her earliest origins on the island of Cyprus to her enduring presence in art, fashion and popular culture, Aphrodite has been continually reimagined across the centuries. Bringing together archaeology, sculpture, painting, contemporary art and fashion, the exhibition traces Aphrodite's remarkable journey through the ancient Greek and Roman worlds, Renaissance Europe, and into the present day. Discover the myths, images and ideas that transformed an ancient deity into one of the most recognisable figures in Western culture.
